regulatory_frameworks.notes: Release 0.3.0 promotes the 0.3.0rc1 PCG/FEC cross-lot qualification unchanged: immutable source evidence, explicit import mapping, canonical posting, TrialBalance, financial statements, published ReportSnapshot, regulatory projection, validation, canonical export and deterministic evidence replay. Reference account hints remain non-executable unless explicitly validated. Stable package status does not claim exhaustive statutory PCG templates, legal filing certification, DGFiP filing certification or authority-submission compliance.

SYSCOHADA remains qualified through LOT-17 deterministic XOF golden and replay scenarios over published ReportSnapshot inputs with exact reference-model coordinates, validated mapping provenance, validation, canonical export and replayable evidence. The 0.3.0 PCG/FEC source-to-evidence integration is not presented as an equivalent SYSCOHADA ingestion qualification. Candidate/reference hints cannot execute silently. Stable package status does not claim exhaustive official SYSCOHADA filing templates, legal certification or authority-submission compliance.
